agent_explanation: Fast body (~55 m/s, ~0.26 m/step, 9 substeps) reaches the right boundary around step 30 with small penetration but the boundary-wall collision impulse never fires: vx is identical at steps 0,28,29,30,31. With no velocity reflection or effective positional correction, the body coasts straight through and exceeds the 0.15 in_arena tolerance at step 31 (overshoot 0.31). Likely cause is missed discrete boundary contact at high speed / failed substep collision handling.
